title: Jim Dowd and Morgan Stanley Support The Jimmy Fund
description: Jim Dowd of Morgan Stanley  talks about the need for supporting The Jimmy Fund and the Connecticut Patient Assistance Project at Dana-Farber.  Cancer touches many people and it is especially tough when children are stricken.  Many Connecticut families choose to travel to Dana-Farber for treatments.

asr.full_text: This is my second year playing in this tournament. We're from Springfield, Mass, grew up with Tony Ravosa, watched him grow up and become a political heavyweight figure in Connecticut. And, we love the Jimmy Fund and we think it's a great cause, anything to do with children and helping them with fighting cancer. And we'd love to be back next year and the year after. Thank you.
